title: A computer copy can be built at the logical level

statements.text: When a coarse-grained description has its own evolution law, the theorem holds over that description. Digital computers satisfy this at the logical level by design, and computational process theories state their criterion at that level, so the copy $\beta$ can actually be prepared by setting logical states, not atoms.

sources.quote: Digital computers satisfy this condition at the logical level by design, and computational process theories state their criterion at that same level.
